notes.title: Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate is OUT NOW
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/4a4541d5c11d0f52218fad6e8371aae572b16eb2.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111080/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate/

Use magic spells and military surplus explosives to topple an evil crime syndicate hidden beneath a prestigious wizarding school. Learn spells, engage in espionage, and spread lore-unfriendly chaos. 

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/8a10814a7cc6b72e23f82b9f42a3b57ac9509b37.gif

Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate is a comedic sandbox with a complete lack of safety nets or boundaries.  Players are free to indulge in the full abject chaos of untethered physics simulations and uncontainable emergent gameplay, using a toolkit of magical spells and items to solve problems in ways we cannot hope to balance against.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/41808760a60aae8aeb109cad8ea3bb4fddf828b1.gif

Wizard Boy can also team up with other Wizard Boys in cooperative(?) multiplayer to explore (blow up) the castle together and thwart the evil International crime syndicate S.P.I.D.E.R once and for all!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/936ff34a9038dfe99745f535206b311537012ad3.gif

FEATURES

 A multitude of spells to learn and inflict on others
 Chaotic, barely contained physics-based mayhem
 Open-ended goals to accomplish (or ignore) however you see fit
 Online co-op, although actual cooperation is unlikely
 Retro-themed third person action, straight from the days of Unreal Engine 1
 Landmines and other non-magical ordnance


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111080/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate/

notes.title: Butcher's Creek is out now!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/a2a280c65d75ca9252fb955192680d7c1f05a54b.jpg

A troubled loner with a hunger for cinematic gore finds himself on the other side of the camera when rumors of authentic snuff videotapes lead him to an abandoned cabin near Butcher's Creek, Pennsylvania. What starts as illicit urban exploration becomes a fight for survival when he's captured by a gang of sadistic killers. Now his only option is to pick up a box cutter, a hammer, a pickaxe, or whatever else is at hand, and unleash a little video violence of his own.

FEATURES

Use hammers, axes, pipes, 2x4s, box cutters, and more to brutalize anything that stands between you and freedom

When all else fails, the level itself can be a weapon. Kick props into enemies, or enemies into environment hazards.

Photograph gruesome murder scenes to fulfill your dark desires and regain lost health

Explore decaying farmhouses, collapsing factories, and seedy strip clubs in a forgotten corner of the Appalachian Forest

Experience a unique aesthetic combining the gritty shot-on-video look of found footage with the photosourced visual style of Source Engine games

Learn more about the bizarre nightmare world introduced in Squirrel Stapler and The Pony Factory


https://youtu.be/3TLL1g8Z8Y0?si=jCY8kkxFaEhi3XpY
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512560/Butchers_Creek/

notes.title: The Pony Factory is out now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536530/The_Pony_Factory/
Winston arrived at a solution to the moral decay of his town.

He called out to hell, and hell answered. The human body could, hell promised, be twisted and stretched into a kinder, more equine shape. Winston's town, now filled with ignorant hate-mongers, could instead be filled with magical ponies, if he could provide a factory in which to make them. Winston thought they would be beautiful, gentle, and good.

Hell had other plans...

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/f5b229a724a8109c1102ffd3ab63b19ca8c0ae9d.png

The Pony Factory is a short action/horror game inspired by Doom 3, with a darkly comedic story, striking black and white visual style, and visceral FPS gameplay. This is an updated standalone release of the original game, which was created in 7 days as part of the Dread X Collection 1.

FEATURES

Meaty FPS combat against highly agile foes who will attempt to evade and flank you.
Darkness is your enemy!  Use muzzle flashes, sparks, sound, and other clues to track foes during combat.
High contrast black and white aesthetic inspired by early 1950's science fiction films.
A short minimalist campaign that can be completed in about 30 minutes.
Numerous improvements from the original release, including many new quality of life features, balance and game feel improvements, new story and gameplay content, full gamepad support, and of course bugfixes!


https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/95215f003c102674f4b81e4e08fa0ab9bbb4d4dc.png

My brother John Szymanski (director of My Friendly Neighborhood) assisted with this version and will be receiving half of the royalties in an effort to provide him with enough income to continue game development until he begins receiving money from MFN.

John also released his own game today: a tense puzzle/horror game called Exiled:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741620/Exiled/

Both games can be purchased as a bundle together too!

notes.title: Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RD2rc2uuoiY;full][/previewyoutube]
Chop Goblins is (almost) one year old!

Well, technically it will be one year old on December 12th, but that's two days after both Dusk and Doom are having big anniversary milestones so... we're doing a Chop Goblins anniversary celebration today instead!

Here's what the Anniversary Update brings to the game...

NEW WEAPONS

Enjoy two powerful new weapons... the Scattergun and the Six Shooter.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/cffbfcf26457af59b2f8ff3a31f6749d0dd7ab66.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/9d055654bd74ba6dff35196b0fa843894d09094f.jpg

These will replace the Flintlock and Street Sweeper respectively if you turn on "Alt Weapons" on the difficulty selection screen, but you can still use both the Flintlock and Street Sweeper by hitting the corresponding weapon selection key twice.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/b41024b5a7141767c77d2c8e548378a6f8c9f90f.png

Which means that it is now both easy and effective to quickswap between all six weapons, if you want to try playing Chop Goblins like it's Doom Eternal.  You should, it's fun.

BETTER DAGGER
A bit, at least.  The dagger now attacks slightly faster and does slightly more damage, allowing you to consistently one-shot low level enemies (i.e the annoying brown ones) and better deflect projectiles.

CHOKE UPGRADE NOW IN MAIN LEVELS
The Street Sweeper's choke upgrade, previously found only in the bonus levels, can now be acquired in the original campaign as well.  I don't actually remember where I put it though.  Someone let me know.

THE GAME RUNS BETTER
Most of you will probably have to take my word for it, but Chop Goblins should run better on lower end machines now, thanks to a collection of different optimizations and tweaks under the hood.

CELEBRATE ONE YEAR OF MURDERING CHOP GOBLINS
I wanted to try getting maybe a bonus level and/or a free release of all the game assets done as part of this update also, but I just didn't end up having the time with the new baby and all.  But hopefully you enjoy the new weapons, and jumping back in to celebrate one year of wholesale goblin slaughter.  While Chop Goblins isn't the most successful, the deepest, or the best game I've made, it's one I'm extremely fond of, and I've enjoyed supporting it with new content and fixes.  Only time will tell what else the future holds for the goblins...

notes.title: God is coming, September 15th...
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/44a02a67259b893e9cfd71b07904bacfa56d9b89.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535830/Squirrel_Stapler/

IT IS TIME TO HUNT THE SQUIRRELS...
A lonely man living in a remote cabin wakes up one day and realizes his beloved--a dismembered corpse nailed to the cabin wall--has been made ugly and rotten by the flies that swarm her. He wishes she were beautiful, like the squirrels of the wood. And so he sets out to hunt the squirrels of the wood, so that he might staple them to her and make her beautiful again.

Originally created as part of The Dread X Collection II, Squirrel Stapler is a horror hunting simulator that satirizes low budget edutainment games with pitch black humor and panic-inducing absurdist horror, and a new and improved standalone version is coming September 15th!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/83f766b4a2e6747a0eaf84e28965d8e7aa4f2653.png

IN SQUIRREL STAPLER YOU CAN...

Hunt squirrels! Move quietly, hide in bushes, stay low, and pick the right time to pull the trigger!
Lure even bigger squirrels with a squirrel call!
Be wary of larger creatures and vengeful ghosts! You aren't the only alpha predator in the forest!
Freely explore a large nonlinear map littered with educational squirrel facts and more!
Meet god! 


For more information, check out the Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535830/Squirrel_Stapler/

notes.title: This madcap five buck microshooter just got a surprise free content update
notes.content:
Dusk creator David Szymanski has been busy, cranking out two fantastic micro games in the past year, one of which is being made into a movie. The other, more recent project, Chop Goblins, is a far more arcadey and carefree affair than Iron Lung, and the half-hour FPS just got an update with new levels and features...
                Read more.

notes.title: Free Content Update: Remix Levels and more!
notes.content:
Version 1.3 brings free new content to Chop Goblins, in the form of 5 bonus remix levels and Nilbog Mode, along with bigfixes.


BONUS REMIX LEVELS
Play through more challenging remixed and re-ordered versions of the five levels, featuring adjustments to times of day, enemy spawns, weapon progression, and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/1f7daea804fa6ebb00b3375e0add5e08bd5ecf5c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/e25374c0c1ed58b9cd8b3583a2026a384bb428ae.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/604da491b1ed0e3474eb49e534d3da7435cf4b6f.jpg


NILBOG MODE
Nilbog Mode lets you play through mirrored versions of levels both new and old.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/bd3d687f0f4ae286cb83e4c115aae5302e9bc6c4.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/09bc8bf3a07c10b1e4b5ba2420c71d1105f07557.jpg


CABINET OF CURIOSITIES
Update 1.3 is free to all players, but if you want to "pay" for it you can purchase the Cabinet of Curiosities DLC for 99 cents, which features a collection of Chop Goblins wallpapers, avatars, memes (by the ever-great Kino Fabino), and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/c18c67ffbfb787bd266b70a4a115261dd7f0ba0e.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2409650/Chop_Goblins__Cabinet_of_Curiosities/


FULL CHANGELOG

Added remixed levels!
Added Nilbog Mode (mirror mode)
UI interaction prompt will now scale properly to lower resolutions
Keyboard can be used to navigate main menu (requires bindings to be reset to defaults once to start working)
Fixed issue where damaging hazards wouldn't harm the player

notes.title: Update 1.3 on testing branch
notes.content:
Update 1.3 is now on the testing branch, for anyone who wants to help test it!  This update will add bonus remixed levels, a mirror mode ("Nilbog mode") and several bug fixes.

To access the testing branch, right click on the game in your Steam library, click "properties," then "betas" and select the "testing" branch.

For a full list of changes, consult "changelog.txt" in the Chop Goblins install folder.

notes.title: Version 1.21
notes.content:
Version 1.21


Added controller bindings to keybind menu
Fixed issue where joystick sensitivity varied depending on game framerate.  Keybinds may need to be reset to defaults for this fix to be applied.

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2

Added ability to rebind controls!
Subway car in Streets now respects game volume settings
Removed some distortion from the main menu as it made text slightly hard to read on some displays
Fixed issue where crosshair wouldn't scale correctly to lower resolutions

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
Version 1.1


Pressing esc when you are dead will now restart the level instead of opening the pause menu
Fixed potential softlock location in Museum
Fixed some lightmapping artifacts in Museum
Added collision to the cybergoblin
Game can now be beaten in sightseeing mode
End screen and main menu leaderboards will no longer overflow
End screen leaderboard is now labelled as "friend leaderboard"
Added master volume setting
HOPEFULLY fixed all weirdness having to do with settings menu
Added all enemy VOs to the goodies folder (have fun!)

notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.content:
Screenshotting the end game screen will no longer result in a surprise screenshot of the Unity default skybox
More invisible walls in Greece to prevent unintentional out of bounds

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.content: Slo mo setting will now save correctly

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.content:
Added a secret someone's boss music to the goodies folder
Added invisible wall to the rooftop area of Greece to prevent players from softlocking by getting out of the level
Added killplane to Greece and Streets, in case you get out of bounds
Changed minimum mouse sensitivity value from 1 to 0.1
